pages.text: Kiboko Money Market Fund factsheet, issued by Moyo Asset Managers (SYN). Kiboko Money Market Fund is a money market fund and its objective is to preserve capital and provide daily liquidity. The management fee of Kiboko Money Market Fund is 1.7 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Kiboko Money Market Fund is SYN Sh 10,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 500. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Kiboko Money Market Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 7.1 percent.

Withdrawals from Kiboko Money Market Fund are paid within 3 business days. The main holdings of Kiboko Money Market Fund are commercial paper (55 percent), short-dated government paper (40 percent) and call deposits (25 percent). SYN Trust Company acts as trustee of Kiboko Money Market Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Kiboko Money Market Fund was launched in 2010 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall.
